verdict.rationale: The desktop app can install and run MCP connectors that live on your machine or local network, so a developer can write an MCP server and load it locally. LobeHub also names SKILL.md bundles as its skill format, and ships CLIs for installing skills and publishing MCP plugins. However, the evidence comes from changelog and marketing snippets rather than authoring docs, and local loading is shown only for the desktop app. Missing for 10: a documented plugin/skill authoring spec or tutorial, evidence of loading custom skills into a self-hosted or web instance, and hands-on or independent corroboration of the local dev loop.
